scope: Original complete CGRA and general five-unit ASIC checkpoints; not the split Add/ReLU baseline or newly pipelined Softmax.
units: SAED14 library area units; not place-and-route area.
definition: Compute plus control excluding identified bulk storage cells. Remove SRAM macros and named configuration/data array flops only. Retain array decode/read/write mux logic, operand register files, FIFO/queue registers, FSMs, pipeline registers, prologue counters, interconnect, validity state, and adapters/DMA unless reporting the separate core subtotal.
limitations: This accounting boundary is not a synthesized memory-free accelerator. Access logic remains and depends on the original storage sizes.
Control includes mutable prologue counters and configuration-cache validity metadata. Bulk configuration payload arrays are separated.
Installed compute resources differ: reusable 16-PE CGRA versus the five dedicated ASIC units, excluding their common Gemmini.
Both original mapped endpoints fail 2 ns. These areas do not qualify matched-frequency PPA.
Complete endpoint and core subtotals have distinct boundaries; neither should be silently substituted for the other.
Separating array access logic from shared arithmetic/control would require a different boundary and additional structural evidence; these results retain that logic on both sides.
